description: Implementation of a stream producer for D3D11 textures in ANGLE, including functions for texture description extraction, validation, and management within the rendering pipeline.

classes.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture
classes.description: Manages D3D11 texture streaming, including validation, description retrieval, and resource management.

methods.name: GetGLDescFromTex
methods.description: Extracts OpenGL texture description from a D3D11 texture based on format and plane index.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::validateD3DTexture
methods.description: Validates that a given D3D11 texture is compatible and originated from the correct device.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::postD3DTexture
methods.description: Updates the internal texture reference with a new D3D11 texture and associated attributes.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::getGLFrameDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenGL description of the current texture frame for a specific plane.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::getD3DTexture
methods.description: Returns the current D3D11 texture pointer.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::getArraySlice
methods.description: Returns the array slice index of the texture.
